resumeText:
CHLOE NGUYEN
Perth, WA | 0400 000 000 | chloe.nguyen@example.com
Australian Citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Recent Data Science graduate skilled in SQL, Python and dashboarding, with hands-on experience turning retail and operations data into reports that support decision-making. Looking to grow as a Junior Data Analyst in Perth.

SKILLS
- Python (pandas, NumPy)
- SQL (Postgres, MySQL)
- Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP)
- Tableau
- Power BI
- Statistics and A/B testing

EXPERIENCE

Data Analyst, Quantum Metrics Pty Ltd, Perth WA
06/2024 - Present
- Built weekly SQL reports summarising delivery performance across 12 regional warehouses, cutting manual reporting time from 4 hours to 45 minutes.
- Lead the migration of ad-hoc Excel trackers into a single Power BI dashboard used by 20 staff.
- Clean and validate incoming shipment data, flagging an average of 15 data entry errors per week before they reached the finance team.

Junior Data Analyst, Insight Analytics Co, Perth WA
03/2024 - 11/2024
- Analysed customer churn data for a telco client, identifying a segment responsible for 18% of cancellations and presenting findings to the account manager.
- Wrote Python scripts to automate monthly churn reports, reducing turnaround from 3 days to same-day delivery.
- Supported senior analysts in building SQL queries against a Postgress database for ad-hoc client requests.

Data Analyst Intern, BrightRetail Pty Ltd, Perth WA
02/2023 - 07/2023
- Built a Tableau dashboard tracking sales across 40 stores, which the merchandising team now checked every morning before placing orders.
- Cleaned and merged three years of point-of-sale data in Excel, resolving inconsistent product codes affecting 6% of records.
- Presents findings to the merchandising team fortnightly on fast-moving stock lines.

Customer Service Officer (Part-time, while studying), Coles Supermarkets, Perth WA
01/2021 - 12/2022
- Handled customer enquiries and processed returns during evening and weekend shifts around university timetable.
- Trained four new casual staff on point-of-sale procedures.

PROJECTS

Perth Rental Price Explorer
- Scraped and cleaned 5,000 rental listings using Python, then built a regression model to estimate price by suburb, achieving an R-squared of 0.71.

University Attendance Dashboard
- Designed a Power BI dashboard for a student society committee, visualising attendance trends across 15 events to help plan room bookings.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Science (Data Science), Curtin University, Perth WA
02/2020 - 11/2023
- Relevant units: Database Systems, Applied Statistics, Machine Learning, Data Visualisation.

REFERENCES
Available on request.
